reviews.comment: Dr. Shao taught me about the magic anti-elephant particle. 11/10 class, hope I get him again. (Please please please let me into your lab Dr. Shao)

Dr. Shao is super intelligent and a great teacher. As long as you get that "enerj" means "energy," he can explain the most complex topics in a comprehensible way. He really cares about the students and makes sure everyone passes. He gives weekly/bi-weekly homeworks which aren't too bad as long as you pay attention in class. Text is free pdf online.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures
